q1.explanationZh: 第一句里 Stanton 心想“没人会看这么长的帖子”，说明他一开始觉得很少有人会感兴趣。

evidence.quote: “Nobody is going to read a 33-part story on social media,”

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说他大学毕业后头两年在做金融工作，后来才去拍街头照片，所以他以前是金融从业者。

evidence.quote: Stanton spent his first two years after college working in finance.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说访客对他和拍摄对象的谈话更感兴趣，不是对照片本身。

evidence.quote: Visitors to his blog were more interested in the conversations Stanton was having with his subjects.

q4.explanationZh: 他说自己不只会拍照（①），还能让陌生人愿意敞开心扉（④），所以选①④。

evidence.quote: I could make them feel comfortable enough to open up before taking their picture.

q5.explanationZh: 第五段说他和拍摄对象的交谈从两分钟变成了一个小时，也就是花了更多时间聊天。

evidence.quote: Stanton went from spending two minutes with a subject to having hour-long conversations.

q6.explanationZh: 最后一段说他不会放慢脚步，还想认识更多人、发现更多故事，说明他打算继续拍摄项目。

evidence.quote: But the photographer isn’t slowing down.
